source.archive: Cui, Li, and Zhou OSF replication archive
source.source_article: Tröster and Van Quaquebeke (2021), When victims help their abusive supervisors
authorized_normalizations: Locked helping items 31-36 as primary and retained self-blame 23-25 and guilt 26-30 as secondary.
omitted_source_measures: Source items 1-22 were omitted from routine calls as nonfocal checks under the Reviewer 1 item-reduction decision.

population.simulation_target: Employee reflecting on a relationship with supervisor Chris

materials.participant_role: Act as the employee in the described supervisor relationship. Respond for yourself and do not analyze the experiment.
materials.common_scenario: Your supervisor is Chris. Your prior relationship quality and Chris's recent conduct are described below.

high_lmx_abuse.label: High Lmx Abuse
high_lmx_abuse.stimulus: You and Chris previously had a trusting, supportive, high-quality working relationship. Chris has now ridiculed and demeaned you in an abusive interaction.

high_lmx_nonabuse.label: High Lmx Nonabuse
high_lmx_nonabuse.stimulus: You and Chris have a trusting, supportive, high-quality working relationship. Chris interacts with you normally and respectfully.

low_lmx_abuse.label: Low Lmx Abuse
low_lmx_abuse.stimulus: You and Chris previously had a distant, transactional, low-quality working relationship. Chris has now ridiculed and demeaned you in an abusive interaction.

low_lmx_nonabuse.label: Low Lmx Nonabuse
low_lmx_nonabuse.stimulus: You and Chris have a distant, transactional, low-quality working relationship. Chris interacts with you normally and respectfully.

materials.response_instruction: Rate self-blame items 1-7 and guilt/helping items 1-5. Return only integer responses.

items.text: I would try to help Chris.
I would speak highly about Chris.
I would go out of my way to be nice to Chris.
I would include Chris in conversations.
I would make myself available to Chris.
I would defend Chris's opinions and suggestions.
I am responsible for damaging the relationship.
I am to blame for risking the relationship.
I feel tension about something I did.
I cannot stop thinking about a bad thing I did.
I feel like apologizing or confessing.
I feel bad about something I did.

research_restricted.aligned_hypothesis_text: The abuse effect on supervisor-directed helping is more positive under high than low LMX.
research_restricted.reversed_hypothesis_text: The abuse effect on supervisor-directed helping is not more positive under high than low LMX.
